plan.sampling: no warmup, cache flush, retries or discarded samples; fixed case order
plan.fixture: M[s][i]=(37*i+101*s+9) mod p; coefficient limb[k]=37*seed+17*k+9; primitive a seed=i+opening+1, b seed=i+opening+7; A1 coefficient seed=17
plan.statement: conditional Circle certificates and functional openings; A1 id71, originals41/42/43, P=coefficient*input0+0*input2 (input1 unused); every original is opened
plan.timing: inclusive native fixture/preparation/registration, coefficients, production, actual consumers, continuations, receipt observations and protocol buffer cleanup; A1 includes full point replay; excludes build, process launch, argument parsing and receipt JSON serialization
plan.memory: fresh-worker whole-pipeline peak RSS, including source/prepared trees, retained certificates/proofs, encoder scratch/twiddles, all consumers, stack, runtime and allocator retention; not isolated verifier RSS
plan.capacities: actual PreparationWork and caller proof/input capacities only; not a complete PCS/A1 owned-vector peak; never sum separate stage peaks; both primitive proofs retained through the second consumer
plan.usage: cumulative shared-transcript snapshots retained separately from per-call Merkle work; registration and A1 replay have distinct transcripts; no adversarial caps or loss probabilities
plan.proof_sizes: separate canonical certificate/opening bytes and A1 message payloads/public framing; no inference container
plan.correctness: each measured proof fully consumed natively; receipt checks exact shapes, query counts, wire sizes, original records and continuation; independent byte parity/all59 policies/negative controls remain task gates
plan.scope: bounded CPU micro measurements with all named consumers active; standard schema tag only; no profile, inference, privacy, fit, speedup or one-weight-pass claim; concurrent original research workers left running
